title: Vanishing orders, suspensions and zero degree Turán densities
summary: For integers $1\le \ell<k$, the $\ell$-degree Turán density $π_\ell(F)$ measures the minimum $\ell$-degree threshold that forces a copy of a fixed $k$-uniform hypergraph $F$, generalizing both the classical Turán density $π_1$ and the codegree Turán density $π_{k-1}$. Motivated by Erdős' characterization of $k$-graphs with zero Turán density, we study the structural implications of vanishing $\ell$-degree Turán density. Our main result concerns the case $\ell=2$.
